messages.content: Can you take a checkout flow rewrite?
Yes, taking a checkout flow rewrite.
Where are we?

Nothing is waiting on anyone at the moment. The empty and loading states for every panel has been live since Tuesday with no complaints. The trade-offs all pointed to Zustand instead of Redux for local state. The bulk of the diff sits in tests/dashboard.spec.ts.
Status please.
Somebody has to own offline support for the draft editor before Friday. Turns out the slowdown was an infinite re-render from an unstable dependency array all along.
Where are we?
Thanks to optimistic updates on the toggle controls, the on-call pages stopped.
Where are we?
The pager went off twice overnight because of a CORS failure against the staging API.
Status please.
The metrics grid with responsive breakpoints is behind us now. Ping me if anything seems wrong.
How is a checkout flow rewrite going?
MSW for mocking the API in tests is the direction we committed to.
Radix primitives for accessible components feels like the right fit here.
Makes sense, doing that.
What landed?

Focus trapping in the modal component has been live since Tuesday with no complaints. Had to untangle src/hooks/useMetrics.ts first. Tailwind for styling is what everything will be built on from here. We might revisit this next quarter.
Next steps for a checkout flow rewrite?
Should we add more coverage? The toast notification system came off the board this morning.
Carry on.
Most of yesterday disappeared into a memory leak from an unsubscribed event listener. React 19 with the compiler enabled is what everything will be built on from here.
